reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Tea Tree Calming Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text:
I’ve used this Real Teatree Calming Care Mask a few times now, and it’s become one of my go-tos when my skin feels congested or irritated. It has a mild tea tree scent, not overpowering, and it really helps to calm redness and reduce inflammation after breakouts.

My skin is combination and acne-prone, and this mask gives me the perfect balance of oil control and hydration. It doesn’t dry me out, but it does leave my skin feeling clean, soothed, and visibly calmer.

I love that it’s vegan and biodegradable — a great bonus. I keep these on hand for “bad skin days” or after hot, humid weather. Definitely worth trying if you’re dealing with breakouts or oily patches.
reviews.zh:
我已經用咗呢款 Real Teatree Calming Care 面膜幾次，每次皮膚覺得堵塞或者受刺激嘅時候，佢已經成為我嘅首選之一。佢有淡淡嘅茶樹味，唔會太濃，真係有助退紅同舒緩爆瘡後嘅炎症。

我嘅皮膚係混合性而且容易爆瘡，呢款面膜喺控油同保濕之間做到完美平衡。佢唔會令我覺得乾，但係用完會覺得皮膚清爽、舒緩、明顯鎮靜咗。

我好鍾意佢係純素同可生物降解——加分位。「皮膚差嘅日子」或者又熱又潮濕嘅天氣過後，我都會用佢。如果你好似我咁要對付暗瘡或者油脂粒，真係值得一試。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Tea Tree Calming Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: One of the best most hydrating masks . I’ve always loved Korean skin care but when my skin was going through a reaction … an unknown rash developed and I could not use anything on my skin care regimen. I needed something mild and healing while being very hydrating as I have dry mature skin. I was blown away by the fact that this healed my skin while keeping it supple and looking good. My skin is now healed and I am so grateful to have had this to maintain my skin while it was healing!!!
reviews.zh: 最好、最保濕嘅面膜之一。我一直都鍾意韓國護膚品，但係有一排我嘅皮膚出現咗反應……出咗一種不明嘅紅疹，護膚流程上咩都唔敢用。我需要一款溫和、有修復力嘅產品，同時要非常保濕，因為我係乾性成熟肌膚。令我驚喜嘅係，呢款面膜喺幫我修復皮膚嘅同時保持住皮膚柔軟，狀態望落都好好。我嘅皮膚而家已經好返，我好感恩當時有呢款產品可以喺修復期間維持到我嘅皮膚!!!
